sentences.en: Most are ill-adapted to the demands of modern, mechanised agriculture and, unless converted to new uses, may well disappear.

sentences.en: This is sometimes used in mechanised cleaning where a cold water rinse can facilitate the removal of detergent from a system.

sentences.en: The move follows reports that a new mechanised suction dredge is breaking up river banks, blocking rivers and killing fish.

sentences.en: Perhaps, in time, this treatment will be mechanised.

sentences.en: The Imperial Gurad makes much use of mechanised armour and motorised transport.

sentences.en: Nearly all the growth has come from large, mechanised farms in the south-central region—hundreds of miles away from the Amazon rainforest.

sentences.en: "In this mechanised working face, this single shaft and single face ranks No 1 in China ... in the world we are No 1, " he says.

sentences.en: Already intensively cultivated and mechanised, there are few opportunities for farmers to increase output by improving yields on existing acreage.

sentences.en: The 55 th Mechanised Brigade was a unit of Clone troopers that fought during the Clone Wars.
sentences.vi: Lữ đoàn Cơ giới số 55 là một đơn vị lính Người nhái đã chiến đấu trong các cuộc Chiến tranh Người sao.
